item.title: CaDiCaL vs Kissat vs CryptoMiniSat in 2026: Which SAT Solver Should You Actually Deploy?
item.description: Every time a build system resolves a dependency graph, a hardware team verifies a chip, or a config tool checks whether two firewall rules can ever conflict, something is answering the same question: is there an assignment of true/false to these variables that satisfies all these constraints? That question is the Boolean satisfiability problem, it is NP-complete in the worst case, and the reason it is usable in practice is that a handful of carefully engineered CDCL solvers can crack industrial instances with hundreds of thousands of variables.
